Home.title: CONCERT-PIANIST
Home.quote: "The result is a pianistic drama of overwhelming power on the one hand and poetry on the other."
Home.aboutText1: Giovanni Bertolazzi made his mark on the international scene by winning 2nd prize and 5 special prizes at the 'F. Liszt' International Piano Competition in Budapest.
Home.aboutText2: He officially performed on the World's longest Concert-grand Piano during its first public presentation, the BORGATO GRAND-PRIX 333 (3.33 meters long).
Home.aboutText3: In 2024, he was awarded the 43rd 'Liszt Ferenc International Grand Prix Du Disque' by the Liszt Society of Budapest for his Liszt recordings.
Home.aboutText4: Highlights of his career include appearances with the Hungarian Philharmonic Orchestra, the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino, the MAV Symphony Orchestra, the Orchestra del Teatro La Fenice.
